body:
## Problem

The match draft #1252 depends on seven unrelated syntax PRs and rejects promoting integers in sequence patterns. Very large hexadecimal patterns can also crash compilation.

## Change

Extract bounded matching onto current main: literals, captures, alternatives, guards, fixed tuples and plain dataclasses. Preserve subject evaluation, staged captures, false-guard bindings and field/callback order. Fix both integer defects. Right-associate generated conditions to reduce capture bookkeeping without changing guard semantics. Add composition regressions, a command example with 11 shared pytest cases, and reproducible match-versus-conditional benchmarks. General sequences, mappings and custom class matching remain outside scope. Implemented and independently reviewed with ChatGPT assistance. Refs #1252.

## Validation

Initial tree 620c35f passed compiler/runtime fixed points, 42 focused checks normally and under GC stress, 104 mode-combination checks, 25 adapted pyperformance workloads, 78 shared pytest checks, seven extended workloads and 2,299 recordings. Real pyperf measurements exposed a JIT capture penalty. The final conjunction change passed 42 focused checks and a new guard-order regression; its pilot halves that penalty. Exact-head bootstrap, full CI, corpus IR comparison and final timings are running. Draft pending qualification.
